properties.name: assembly
properties.description: The reference assembly identifier the track is defined against (e.g. GRCh38, mm10). A free identifier for now.

properties.name: build_sex
properties.description: The sex of the reference genome build (which sex chromosomes the assembly contains). Factored out of compound DataType terms like "male genome reference" / "female genome index". A property of the reference assembly, NOT of the biological sample. Absent means unspecified / sex-neutral combined assembly.
